name: Tammaritu II
role: Ruler of Elam from 652 to 650/649 BC
contribution: The ruler of Elam from 652 until 650 or 649 BC.

checks.lead: Tammaritu II was the ruler of Elam from 652 until 650 or 649 BC. After the brief reigns of Indabibi and Humban-haltash III, Tammaritu II was briefly restored to power in 648. Tammaritu II was the son of Tammaritu I and the successor of Ummanigash, his uncle.
